# Scanner Rig SR-1

The Scanner Rig SR-1 is an overhead camera rig with a glass book cradle, for
photographing bound pages. It is made by [[pemberton-scanning]] and stored
at [[tolvan-lab]].

## Calibration

The rig's colour and focus are calibrated once a year.
